import subprocess, os, tempfile

def handle(query, state):
    flag = state.get("flag", "")
    flag_file = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "secret.txt")
    with open(flag_file, "w") as f:
        f.write(flag)
    name = (query.get("name") or [""])[0]
    result = subprocess.run(
        f"echo hello {name}",
        shell=True,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True
    )
    output = result.stdout if result.stdout else "hello \n"
    return 200, {"Content-Type": "text/plain"}, output
